author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
What begins as an organizing exercise with his favorite vintage IKEA cabinet becomes a shop infrastructure build as Adam revamps the cave's storage and distribution of rubber nitrile gloves. Where are the spots that make the most sense to have these essential shop supplies?
